<description>
Moved from #35302 due to https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35302#issuecomment-7126751401.

This PR:
- refactors `CreateRateBumpTransaction` to return a `util::Expected` of a Result and Error Struct instead of using out params.  This change makes it easier for #35302 to add a sp_recipients field to the Result Struct instead of adding a new output parameter.
- rejects an `original_change_index` that specifies an output without a destination. The pre-existing behaviour silently replaced the specified output if an `OP_RETURN` output was specified.
</description>

[2026-11-24] r:6039939744 review COMMENTED by rustaceanrob (member) (edited 2026-11-24):
Concept ACK

As I mentioned in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35302#issuecomment-7126751401, this can replace an `OP_RETURN` which is posting a proof for a meta protocol or similar. I agree that this should throw an error explicitly as this a mistake on behalf of the user.

To be precise in what I mean for other reviewers:
```
TX A:
-----------------------
Input A |  Pay Bob
Input B |  OP_RETURN
Input C |  Change
-----------------------

Replacement of A, with original_change_index=1
------------------------------------
Input A | Pay Bob
Input B | Some new change address
Input C | Other change address
Input D |
------------------------------------
```

In the replacement the `OP_RETURN` is replaced with a new change address
